suite_negotiation.conclusion: The logged client was recognized as native; the suite unsupported-client passive guard does not explain the failure.

configuration.user_reported_failure: Stored Elytra fails to repair from XP in a standalone netherite pouch or a pouch attached to Mending leggings; held/worn/ordinary inventory repair works.

finding.cause: Clumps injects a cancellable early return into ExperienceOrb.repairPlayerItems at mixin priority 1001. That return bypasses the suite lower-priority RETURN injection for stored wings.
finding.fix: Wrap the entire XP equipment repair pass and process only returned leftover XP; explicitly preserve optional SSO regular-Mending policy.
